facts.fact: 晚上七点马克斯在 Elenmoor 与四位继承人共进晚餐，这件事让她一整天心里发沉。
facts.quote: Seven o’clock. Dinner with the heirs at Elenmoor—the weight of it had sat in my chest like a swallowed stone all day.

facts.fact: 卡斯平在吉普车还没停稳时就冲出门来，从弗罗斯特少校手里接过了马克斯。
facts.quote: Caspian shot out the front door before the jeep had fully stopped, all that restless wolf energy rolling off him.

facts.fact: 艾尔因多尔宣布计划奏效：新哥伦比亚与避难所都接受了邀请，桑德几天内就会到达。
facts.quote: “Our plan is working,” Aelindor said. “Both New Columbia and the Haven have accepted our invitations. Xander will be here in a few days.”

facts.fact: 艾尔因多尔宣布行动代号为“夜莺行动”（Operation Nightingale），马克斯将带一支七人小队行动，并可自行否决名单上的任何人。
facts.quote: “Along with a team of seven. You’ll review the list, and you can veto anyone on it.”

facts.fact: 马可与弗罗斯特自荐随行，马克斯提前为两人各做了一只寒铁护臂并完成绑定。
facts.quote: I’d made two extra Coldiron armguards, one for each of them.

facts.fact: 马克斯在三位继承人各自陈述之后，选择卡斯平和尼古拉伊与自己同行，回绝了德拉肯。
facts.quote: I gave the heirs a small nod. “I’ll take Caspian and Nikolai, gentlemen.”

facts.fact: 马克斯要求把学员布琳加入行动队，把队伍扩为八人。
facts.quote: “I want to add Cadet Bryn and make it a team of eight,” I said.

facts.fact: 马克斯说先知（Oracle）会帮她找到妹妹；她抬起手腕时寒铁在护臂中嗡鸣，室温下降了几度。
facts.quote: I lifted my wrist. Coldiron hummed inside the armguard, and the temperature in the room dropped a few degrees.
